name: Rajesh K.
feedback: AI Twin ne presentation ka kaam bilkul transform kar diya. Pehle 10 demos karne padte the unqualified leads ko, ab sirf 2-3 qualified calls. Time saved = ₹2L+ in billable hours.

name: Priya S.
feedback: ICE system se pipeline predictable ho gayi. WhatsApp automation alone saved 15 hours/week. ROI dikha 6 weeks mein. Highly recommend for agency owners!

name: Amit D.
feedback: Skeptical tha initially kyunki bahut saare 'automation' tools flop hote hain. But results speak - 3 months mein ₹12L ki pipeline just from AI Twin + ICE nurturing. Game changer for solo coaches.

name: Sneha M.
feedback: ProofLoop is genius! Unqualified leads se bhi value nikal liya - social proof automatically build ho raha hai. Aur bonus delivery system bhi bahut smooth. Loved it.

name: Vikram R.
feedback: Doctor-frame approach bilkul alag hai from typical Indian sales tactics. No pushy calls, no spam. System genuine hai aur results bhi. Worth every rupee. 5/5 from me.

name: Kavya T.
feedback: AI Twin slides bahut well-structured hain. 80/20 value-pitch balance perfect hai. Clients ko value mila even before selling. Closing conversations easy ho gayi. Minus 1 star for initial setup time.

name: Arjun M.
feedback: Demo-to-close rate doubled. Unqualified trials kam ho gaye. Sales cycle 45 days se 20 days. Team pe pressure kam, revenue badh gayi. No-brainer investment.

name: Divya N.
feedback: Project-based se retainer shift karna tha. ICE helped with positioning and nurturing. 4 retainer clients in 2 months. System works but needs patience initially.

name: Rohan G.
feedback: Luxury property sales mein trust building slow hoti hai. AI Twin + WhatsApp drip ne process speed up kar diya. HNI clients bhi comfortable feel karte hain. Brilliant system.

name: Meera L.
feedback: Compliance-heavy industry mein automation mushkil lagti thi. But ICE ne selling ko consultative bana diya. Trust factor improved. Referrals bhi increase hui. Very happy!

name: Karan J.
feedback: CTO-as-service selling karna tough tha. AI Twin ne authority positioning solid kiya. Enterprise deals easier ho gayi. Proposal fatigue kam. 4/5 (setup thoda time-consuming).

name: Pooja C.
feedback: Budget mismatch waale inquiries bilkul kam ho gayi. Pre-qualified leads mil rahe hain. Virtual consultation to booking rate 60%+. Time bachta hai for actual design work. Love it!
